subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw expose `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in keyless Firecrawl web_search provider despite Firecrawl's OpenAPI still declaring bearer auth and the privacy/support boundary for hosted no-auth queries?
rationale: The code shape is narrow and current live no-auth search succeeds, but making a public provider id for anonymous hosted search is a maintainer-owned product and security-boundary choice rather than a purely mechanical fix.

options.title: Hold for explicit contract approval
options.body: Require maintainer approval or upstream documentation/confirmation of durable no-auth search before exposing `firecrawl-free` as an official provider.

options.title: Approve the opt-in provider
options.body: Accept the privacy and support boundary, then ask for a rebase and docs overview update before merge.

options.title: Split out tool parity only
options.body: Decline the keyless provider for now and invite a narrower PR that only expands the keyed `firecrawl_search` options.

recommendation.title: Hold for explicit contract approval
recommendation.body: Require maintainer approval or upstream documentation/confirmation of durable no-auth search before exposing `firecrawl-free` as an official provider.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently owned the merged keyless Firecrawl scrape/fetch path and reviewed the opt-in key-free search policy this PR depends on.
